about: Made-up sentences of the kinds a local model wrote in graded packs (2026-11-07), each in a paragraph about one made-up story, marked flagged or not as a careful reader would. These are the checks with no AI, scoped to the paragraph's story: the work placed in the wrong context, a team's work written as solo, and numbers and tools the story's facts lack. Problems only the AI check can see (a module named as the basis of a personal project, a purpose added to fit the advert) are in ai_only, and the checks with no AI must leave them to it.
